component.description: RSH HIDMaestro sidecar (tools/rsh-hm-sidecar/): C# NativeAOT exe, JSON-lines over stdin/stdout. Published AOT (Windows-only, self-contained — no .NET runtime ships with it). The HIDMaestro SDK DLL is NEVER committed to the repo; it is fetched at build time and hash-verified (see tools/rsh-hm-sidecar/README.md). This file is hand-written by H4 because the sidecar has no lockfile (no NuGet packages); regenerate/verify at release time from docs/HIDMAESTRO-SPIKE.md pins.
component.name: rsh-hm-sidecar
